description: Declared mutants of the time-threads-trace plan. A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message (run_mutations.py).

mutants.what: A deadline wake may return up to 1 ms before the deadline
mutants.find: if (bounded && now >= deadline) return {WakeReason::Deadline, deadline, now, LateSince(deadline, now)};
mutants.replace: if (bounded && now + std::chrono::milliseconds(1) >= deadline) return {WakeReason::Deadline, deadline, now, LateSince(deadline, now)};
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake.woke >= deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Notify signals the platform but never sets the latch
mutants.cases: *latches a notification sent before the wait*
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake.reason == WakeReason::Notified \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Notify sets the latch but never signals, so a wait in progress is not woken until its deadline (v8-arch-gyo2-os-wait; only it catches: the signalling half of Notify, where tt1-notify-dropped drops the latch)
mutants.cases: *wakes on a notification from another thread*
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake\.reason == WakeReason::Notified \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A wait discards a notification sent before it started
mutants.replace:
const bool bounded = deadline != TimePoint::max();
    impl_->notified.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
mutants.cases: *latches a notification sent before the wait*
mutants.expect: CHECK\( wake.reason == WakeReason::Notified \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A wake leaves the latch set, so notifications never coalesce
mutants.expect: CHECK\( second.reason == WakeReason::Deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A stop request sets the flag but does not wake the role's wait
mutants.cases: *a stop request wakes a role blocked in its wait*
mutants.expect: the stop request did not wake the role's wait

mutants.what: After a platform wake without the latch, the wait reports the deadline without re-reading the time base
mutants.expect: CHECK\( second.woke >= deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A pending notification is consumed before a passed deadline is reported
mutants.expect: CHECK\( passed.reason == WakeReason::Deadline \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A line refused for a full queue is not counted
mutants.expect: CHECK\( counts.droppedFull > 0 \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Push still accepts lines after Close
mutants.expect: CHECK_FALSE\( sink.Push\("after"\) \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: The take after the stop is counted but never written, so the end line comes too early
mutants.expect: REQUIRE\( tail.size\(\) == 6 \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A Push into an empty queue does not wake the writer
mutants.expect: CHECK\( seen \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: FlushNow returns without waiting for the writer
mutants.expect: CHECK\( size == busy.size\(\) \+ Newline.size\(\) \+ marker.size\(\) \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: The writer also wakes on a timer (polling)
mutants.expect: GYO_ASSERT failed: wake.reason == Time::WakeReason::Notified

mutants.what: A role reports a fixed backend instead of its own Waiter's
mutants.expect: CHECK\( role.WaitBackend\(\) == waiter->Backend\(\) \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A stopped pool still queues a submitted job and answers true (threads.md Invariant 10). Only it reaches the stopping check in Submit
mutants.cases: WorkerPool takes no job after Stop
mutants.expect: CHECK_FALSE\( submitted \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Stop with Drain drops the queued jobs as Discard does (threads.md Invariant 11, Drain). Only it reaches the mode test in Stop
mutants.cases: WorkerPool Stop with Drain runs the jobs already queued
mutants.expect: CHECK\( drained == 5 \+ accepted \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Stop with Discard returns before the running job has finished (threads.md Invariant 11, waiting). Only it reaches the join in Stop for Discard
mutants.replace: if (mode == StopMode::Drain) for (auto& worker : workers_) worker.Join();
mutants.cases: WorkerPool Stop with Discard drops the queued jobs and waits for the running one
mutants.expect: CHECK\( waited \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: Stop with Discard runs the queued jobs as Drain does (threads.md Invariant 11, Discard). The opposite of wp-drain-drops-queued on the same line; only it reaches the Discard case's count
mutants.cases: WorkerPool Stop with Discard drops the queued jobs and waits for the running one
mutants.expect: CHECK\( queuedRan == 0 \) is NOT correct

mutants.what: A worker takes the newest job instead of the oldest (threads.md Contracts: jobs start in the order they were submitted). Only it reaches the order case
mutants.cases: WorkerPool starts jobs in the order they were submitted
mutants.expect: CHECK\( order == expected \) is NOT correct
